gaps: Supplier negotiation (r6) is not explicitly evidenced; the library shows a supplier scorecard and quarterly service-level reviews, not negotiation, so the CV describes performance management only.

The tailoringPlan marks the user criterion 'Lead weekly operational performance reviews' as missing, but entry:ev-head:row:1 confirms running a weekly performance review against published measures, so it is featured as the lead bullet.

Power BI, NetSuite, Process mapping and Vendor management are stored skill labels but were not listed in relevantSkillItems, so only SQL appears as a skill pill; Power BI is covered in the Operations Manager bullet and summary instead.
The advert refers to twelve sites; the evidence confirms eleven community clinics at Northwind Health.
content.name: Rowan Mercer
content.summary: Head of Operations at Northwind Health, leading four operations managers across eleven community clinics with a £14m cost base. Rebuilt rostering around a single demand model, cutting agency spend by 22%, and built the first operational reporting pack in SQL and Power BI.

bullets: Lead four operations managers and a shared scheduling team of eighteen, running a weekly performance review against published measures.
Cut agency spend by 22% in the first year by rebuilding rostering around a single demand model.
Own the operational plan for eleven community clinics, reporting delivery, cost and quality to the executive team every month.
Introduced a supplier scorecard covering the eight largest contracts, with quarterly reviews against agreed service levels.
Partner with finance on the annual budget and on monthly variance across a £14m cost base.
sections.heading: Head of Operations · Northwind Health · Apr 2021 – Present

bullets: Built the first operational reporting pack in SQL and Power BI, replacing a manual month-end spreadsheet, while running day-to-day operations for four clinics and owning the rota, patient flow and site budget.
